reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team. I confirmed that the next Tansleigh Packaging renewal is now 25 September, which replaces the 8 June date they posted this morning.

Their message gave no year, and 25 September 2026 had already passed by the time they wrote (14 October). I said I'd take it as 25 September 2027 and asked Hollis to say if that's wrong.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
